items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: by the name of Bob Shoffner (?) and featured him

ctx.x: I don't know. Charlie Creath was ageless. You couldn't tell about that guy's age, you know. But, he was a tremendous trumpet player. He had the sound of the instrument. At least a sound I liked. And, of course, we'd get on -- I think Gene Sedric was in that band. Fate Marable's band had some tremendous guys. Zooty was in that band. Charlie Creath's band ...

You know performers and people are the greatest people in the world. Not because I'm one of them because I think young. I've seen some tremendous things happen. They brought a fellow in -- I think he worked for Joe Oliver in Chicago -- by the name of Bob Shoffner (?) and featured him. Do you dig up one trumpet player if he's a trumpet player. Can you feature one piano if he's another piano player.
Oh, who did Bob work for then?
